newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan broker Yamane boosts ties with UK affiliates.
newsitem.headline: Japan broker Yamane boosts ties with UK affiliates.

text.p: Yamane Prebon Co Ltd, a Japanese foreign exchange broker, is to beef up its ties with its British affiliates through underwriting its capital stake and lending, a company official said on Tuesday.

The official said the move was aimed at coping with intensifying competition in the Tokyo foreign exchange market and preparing for electronic U.S. Treasuries brokerage services planned by one of the affiliates, Fulton Prebon Group Ltd.
He said Yamane Prebon had underwritten a stake equivalent to 12.5 percent of the capital of Fulton Prebon Group.
The firm had also made a 1.5 billion yen loan to the other affiliate, Prebon Yamane International, with a fixed annual interest rate of two percent.

"By investing and having closer ties with the Fulton Prebon Group, we would like to be ready for the online broking system for U.S. Treasuries proposed by the Fulton Group," said Yosuke Yoshioka, a managing director at Yamane Prebon Co in Japan.
